FN-1RYDZL-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 471
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Government
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/17/2023
House Bill 471 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of certain Class 8
municipalities that opt out of the jurisdiction of a county personnel board, pursuant to this bill,
and subsequently create its own municipal civil service system.
Page 1
